title: LangSmith tracing is enabled
explanation: The image environment turns on LangSmith tracing, which sends prompts, outputs and traces to the LangSmith service (https://api.smith.langchain.com unless LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT says otherwise). The SDK enables tracing only when the variable is exactly "true"; LANGSMITH_TRACING_V2 and LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 are the older names. When a _V2 variable is set and non-empty it takes precedence over the plain one, which this rule does not model, so it can over-report when the two disagree.
fix: Remove the tracing variables from the image, or point LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT at a self-hosted instance inside the enclave.
